description.value: Grand Seasons Restaurant is a Cantonese Chinese eatery in Coquitlam specializing in congee, Hong Kong-style noodles, BBQ meats, and seafood dishes. With 97 online reviews and a reputation for fast service and generous portions, it draws a loyal neighbourhood following. Cyclists passing through the Coquitlam area can order online for quick pickup or dine in for a hearty, affordable meal.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: stands (10 spaces, covered) at 81m; building (covered, paid) at 95m; rack at 96m. Total: 10 spaces.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms the business is a Chinese restaurant at #6-555 Clarke Rd, Coquitlam, with phone 604-939-3968, matching OSM address and URL. The website prominently shows 'Order Online' with 'Pickup 15 min', confirming takeout; the menu legend explicitly marks vegetarian items. No evidence on the website or in OSM tags for bike parking, water refill, washrooms, or most other cycling amenities. A notable data discrepancy exists: the OSM community field says 'North Vancouver' but both the website and the lat/lon place this business in Coquitlam.
concerns: OSM community field is set to 'North Vancouver' but both the website address (#6-555 Clarke Rd, Coquitlam) and the domain name (grandseasonscoquitlam.com) confirm the business is in Coquitlam, not North Vancouver. OSM community tag should be corrected.
OSM had no phone number; phone 604-939-3968 sourced from website only — no OSM value to cross-check against.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: This is a legitimate, active restaurant with takeout and vegetarian options useful to cyclists, but none of the required WWC criteria (bike parking/visibility, water refill, washrooms) can be confirmed from available evidence. An on-site visit or follow-up contact is needed to verify required criteria before inclusion.
